data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 1200 opened 2018 with gross claims outstanding of GBP 772.3m. During 2018 there was an overall reported improvement in prior-year reserves of GBP 11.3m (a release), driven primarily by reserve movements related to catastrophe and prior-year claims development. The syndicate noted significant natural catastrophe activity across 2017 and 2018 (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma, Maria in 2017 and Florence, Michael and California wildfires in 2018) and strengthened reserves in prior years for short-tail exposures (notably North American Property and Marine) where previous rate pressure and increased facility business had lengthened tails. The reported improvements are modest relative to opening reserves and are subject to RITC and development-table distortions described in the notes.
raw_causal_phrases: 2018 was affected by a series of catastrophe events in the second half of the year. Hurricanes Florence and Michael, together with the Californian wildfires cost the industry an estimated $80 billion.

The syndicate has also further strengthened reserves on business written prior to 2018 in short tail lines particularly North American property and Marine lines of business that had seen the most rate pressure in previous years.
In addition to this the year of account was further impacted by the much larger catastrophic events of 2017; Hurricanes - Harvey, Irma and Maria and to a lesser extent the 2017 California wildfires.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development figure is taken from the claims development narrative ('overall improvement of GBP 11.3m') but the report does not provide a clear single GROSS movement note labelled 'movement in prior year's provision' with explicit gross total. The claims development triangle and presence of reinsurance-to-close (RITC) for the 2016 year (closed into 2017) may distort comparisons; triangle parsing in the PDF is noisy. Therefore PYD is reported from the explicit narrative sentence and flagged with moderate confidence.

_claims_triangle.notes: Claims development table exists in the report but contains an aggregated '2012 and prior' column and was affected by RITC reinsurance to close movements; triangulation rows were not extracted reliably for all years. Development rows omitted here due to parsing/RITC distortions; see data_quality_notes.
